SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrMath > 400
  AND sc.Virtual = 'F'

SELECT CDSCode
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` + `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500

SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 0
  AND s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3

SELECT f."School Name" AS school_name,
       s.Street || ', ' || s.City || ', ' || s.State || ' ' || s.Zip AS full_address
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 30

SELECT s.School,
       s.CharterNum,
       sat.AvgScrWrite,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sat.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS Rank
FROM satscores AS sat
JOIN schools AS s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE sat.AvgScrWrite > 499
  AND s.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat.AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT T1.`School Name`
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / T1.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND T2.NumGE1500 >= 1500

SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE s.County = 'Riverside'
  AND sat.AvgScrMath > 400

SELECT s.School AS school_name,
       sat.AvgScrWrite AS avg_writing_score,
       s.Phone AS phone_number
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', s.OpenDate) AS INTEGER) > 1991
   OR CAST(strftime('%Y', s.ClosedDate) AS INTEGER) < 2000

SELECT `School Name`,
       `Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 1.0 / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9

WITH diffs AS (
    SELECT s.School,
           s.DOCType,
           f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS diff
    FROM frpm f
    JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
    WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
)
SELECT School, DOCType
FROM diffs
WHERE diff > (SELECT AVG(diff) FROM diffs)

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
  AND sat.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(sat.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / sat.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH top_school AS (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    WHERE NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY NumGE1500 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT s.AdmFName1 AS first_name, s.AdmLName1 AS last_name
FROM schools s
JOIN top_school t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL OR s.AdmLName1 IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT s.AdmFName2, s.AdmLName2
FROM schools s
JOIN top_school t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL OR s.AdmLName2 IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT s.AdmFName3, s.AdmLName3
FROM schools s
JOIN top_school t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE s.AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL OR s.AdmLName3 IS NOT NULL

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores sat
JOIN schools s ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.District = 'Fresno Unified'
  AND sat.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT s.School AS school_name,
           s.Virtual,
           ss.AvgScrRead,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY ss.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rn
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores ss ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE ss.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT school_name
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5
  AND Virtual = 'F'

SELECT s.School, AVG(sat.AvgScrWrite) AS AvgWritingScore
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE (s.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (s.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (s.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich')
GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.School

SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / 12 AS monthly_avg_schools_opened
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = '52'

SELECT s.School, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = '31'

      SELECT MAX(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)`)
      FROM schools s2
      JOIN frpm f2 ON s2.CDSCode = f2.CDSCode

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = '54' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN DOC = '52' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS ratio
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Orange'

SELECT `School Name`,
       `FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100.0 / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)`
FROM frpm
WHERE `County Name` = 'Los Angeles'

SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS num_schools

WHERE County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')

SELECT GSoffered

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_non_chartered_schools
FROM frpm f

WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS amount_of_more_smes
FROM customers
WHERE Segment = 'SME'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM yearmonth
WHERE Date = '201202'

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2013,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2012
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           c2013,
           c2012,
           (c2013 - c2012) * 100.0 / c2013 AS Percentage
    FROM seg
)
SELECT Segment, Percentage, 'Biggest' AS Type
FROM (SELECT * FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT Segment, Percentage, 'Lowest' AS Type
FROM (SELECT * FROM pct ORDER BY Percentage ASC LIMIT 1)

WITH cust AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' AND Price = 634.8
    LIMIT 1
),
yearly AS (

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND r.year = 2008
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 <> ''
ORDER BY q.q3 ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS total_funds_received
FROM income AS i
JOIN member AS m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.position = 'Vice President'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS medium_tshirt_attendees
FROM attendance a
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
  AND m.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE COALESCE(LOWER(e.type), '') <> 'fundraiser'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_member) > 20

SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE z.state = 'Illinois'

SELECT AVG(e.cost) AS avg_cost
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Elijah'
  AND m.last_name = 'Allen'
  AND substr(e.expense_date, 6, 2) IN ('09', '10')
SELECT notes FROM income WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN substr(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN substr(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020' THEN b.spent ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
SELECT phone FROM member WHERE first_name = 'Carlo' AND last_name = 'Jacobs'

SELECT COUNT(m.member_id) AS medium_tshirt_business_members
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Business'
  AND m.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'

SELECT i.date_received
FROM income i
JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Connor'
  AND m.last_name = 'Hilton'
  AND i.source = 'Dues'

SELECT SUM(cost) AS total_pizza_cost
FROM expense
WHERE expense_description = 'Pizza'

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 20

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city) AS city_count
FROM zip_code
WHERE county LIKE 'Orange%'
  AND state = 'Virginia'

SELECT major.major_name
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.phone = '809-555-3360'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS advertisement_budget_ratio
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement'
  AND e.event_name IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
FROM attendance a
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'

SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name
FROM member m
JOIN major j ON m.link_to_major = j.major_id
WHERE j.department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education'

SELECT e.event_name
FROM expense AS ex
JOIN budget AS b ON ex.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
ORDER BY ex.cost ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN expense x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = x.link_to_member
WHERE e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'

SELECT COUNT(m.member_id) AS member_count
FROM member AS m
JOIN major AS mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Physics Teaching'

SELECT e.event_name
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement'
ORDER BY b.spent DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN x.cost ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(x.cost) AS percentage
FROM expense AS x
JOIN budget AS b ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS attended
FROM attendance a
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Maya'
  AND m.last_name = 'Mclean'
  AND e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'

SELECT e.cost
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event v ON b.link_to_event = v.event_id
WHERE e.expense_description = 'Posters'
  AND v.event_name = 'September Speaker'

SELECT SUM(cost) AS total_expense
FROM expense
WHERE expense_date = '2019-08-20'

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
  AND b.remaining < 0
ORDER BY b.remaining ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT e.expense_description
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha' AND m.last_name = 'Harrison'

SELECT e.expense_description AS expense_type,
       SUM(e.cost) AS total_value
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE ev.event_name = 'October Meeting'
  AND e.approved = 'true'
GROUP BY e.expense_description

SELECT m.last_name, mj.department, mj.college
FROM member AS m
INNER JOIN major AS mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Environmental Engineering'

SELECT DISTINCT b.category
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'
  AND e.type = 'Guest Speaker'
  AND b.spent = 0

SELECT event_name
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Game'
  AND status = 'Closed'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Super Strength'
  AND s.height_cm > 200

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
       m.phone AS contact_number
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)

SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
       i.amount
FROM income AS i
JOIN member AS m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE i.date_received = '2019-09-09'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS hero_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE c.colour = 'Blue'
  AND sp.power_name = 'Agility'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour e ON s.eye_colour_id = e.id
JOIN colour h ON s.hair_colour_id = h.id
WHERE e.colour = 'Blue' AND h.colour = 'Blond'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS gold_eyed_marvel_heroes
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Gold'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

SELECT s.superhero_name,
       s.height_cm,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC) AS height_rank
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
ORDER BY s.height_cm DESC

SELECT r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Copycat'

SELECT c.colour AS eye_colour,
       COUNT(s.id) AS hero_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
GROUP BY c.colour
ORDER BY hero_count DESC

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Durability' AND ha.attribute_value < 50

SELECT DISTINCT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Death Touch'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = 100

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')

SELECT AVG(s.weight_kg) AS average_weight
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm = 185
  AND r.race = 'human'

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE g.gender = 'Male'
LIMIT 5

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190
  AND c.colour = 'No Colour'

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS marvel_percentage
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM hero_power hp
INNER JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE hp.hero_id = 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.hero_id)
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Stealth'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Male'
  AND s.weight_kg > (SELECT AVG(weight_kg) * 0.79 FROM superhero)

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'strength'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT ec.colour AS eye_colour, hc.colour AS hair_colour, sc.colour AS skin_colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN colour ec ON s.eye_colour_id = ec.id
LEFT JOIN colour hc ON s.hair_colour_id = hc.id
LEFT JOIN colour sc ON s.skin_colour_id = sc.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour ec ON s.eye_colour_id = ec.id
JOIN colour hc ON s.hair_colour_id = hc.id
WHERE ec.colour = 'Black' AND hc.colour = 'Black'

SELECT s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.eye_colour_id = s.hair_colour_id
  AND s.hair_colour_id = s.skin_colour_id

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS blue_female_percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
LEFT JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'

SELECT (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Emil Blonsky')
     - (SELECT SUM(weight_kg) FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') AS difference

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination'

SELECT CAST(SUM(height_cm) AS REAL) / COUNT(id) AS average_height
FROM superhero

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percent
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

SELECT a.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = '3-D Man'

SELECT s.superhero_name, p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.superhero_name IN ('Hawkman', 'Karate Kid', 'Speedy')

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan'

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Green' AND a.alignment = 'Bad'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN eye_colour_id = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN eye_colour_id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM superhero
WHERE weight_kg = 0 OR weight_kg IS NULL

SELECT DISTINCT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Wind Control'
ORDER BY s.superhero_name

SELECT DISTINCT g.gender
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
JOIN superhero s ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Phoenix Force'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 1930 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(ID) AS female_born_after_1930_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'

SELECT p.Diagnosis, l.Date
FROM Patient p
LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.ID = 30609

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
       / SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_patient_male,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_male,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
        / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M'

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH > 500

SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_patient_count
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Description) = '1997'
  AND Admission = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1
  AND strftime('%Y', e.`Examination Date`) = '1997'
  AND p.SEX = 'F'

SELECT e.Symptoms, e.Diagnosis
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = (
    SELECT MAX(p2.Birthday)
    FROM Patient p2
    JOIN Examination e2 ON e2.ID = p2.ID
)
AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL

SELECT L.Date,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC, L.Date ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT e.`aCL IgM`
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND p.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND e.`Examination Date` = '1993/11/12'

SELECT DISTINCT ID
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND GPT > 30
  AND ALB < 4
ORDER BY ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', e.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1993
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', e.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 18

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN L.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN L.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END)
      - SUM(CASE WHEN L.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN L.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0
       / SUM(CASE WHEN L.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN L.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) AS decrease_rate
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1959-02-18'
  AND (L.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' OR L.Date LIKE '1981-12-%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'APS'

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND L."T-BIL" < 2.0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)
FROM Examination
WHERE Thrombosis = 2
  AND `ANA Pattern` = 'S'
  AND `aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.UN = 29

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS women_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA'

SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.ID IN (SELECT l.ID FROM Laboratory l WHERE l.GPT > 60)
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_ids
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TG >= 200
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) > 50

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1936 AND 1956
  AND l.CPK >= 250

SELECT AVG(strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Patient AS P
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND P.ID IN (SELECT L.ID FROM Laboratory AS L WHERE L.`T-CHO` >= 250)

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GLU >= 180 AND L.`T-CHO` < 250

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID,
       p.Diagnosis,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.RBC < 3.5

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND l.HGB > 10 AND l.HGB < 17
  AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS female_abnormal_pt_percentage
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) > 55
  AND l.PT >= 14
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lower_than_normal_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS higher_than_normal_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.IGG > 900 AND L.IGG < 2000
  AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.IGA > 80
  AND l.IGA < 500
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) >= 1990

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.RNP IN ('-', '+-')
  AND p.Admission = '+'

SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.ID IN (
    SELECT l.ID
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.IGM <= 40 OR l.IGM >= 400
)
GROUP BY p.Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.SM IN ('-', '+-')
  AND e.Thrombosis = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-')
  AND L.SSB IN ('-', '+-')

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday) AS Birthday
FROM Patient AS P
WHERE P.ID IN (SELECT L.ID FROM Laboratory AS L WHERE L.GOT >= 60)

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
WHERE bond_type IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination AS e
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CPK < 250
  AND (e.KCT = '+' OR e.RVVT = '+' OR e.LAC = '+')

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '+'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(a.atom_id) AS REAL) /
       (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id)
        FROM bond
        WHERE bond_type = '-') AS avg_oxygen_per_single_bonded_molecule
FROM atom a
WHERE a.element = 'o'
  AND a.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-')

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS carbon_percentage
FROM atom AS a
WHERE a.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT b.molecule_id

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2013,
           SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS c2012
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (c2013 - c2012) * 100.0 / c2013 AS percentage_increase
    FROM seg
)
SELECT Segment, percentage_increase
FROM pct
WHERE percentage_increase = (SELECT MAX(percentage_increase) FROM pct)
UNION ALL

FROM pct
WHERE percentage_increase = (SELECT MIN(percentage_increase) FROM pct)
